items.title: 诺奖级AlphaFold团队被拆散，DeepMind科研战略迎重大调整
items.raw_excerpt: 最新消息显示，谷歌DeepMind已解散其旗下AlphaFold团队。AlphaFold论文最初作者中的大多数成员在过去一年里已被重新分配岗位。这支团队打造了凭借蛋白质结构预测技术获得诺贝尔奖认可的人工智能（AI）系统，这一调整标志着这家全球顶尖AI研究机构正在重新制定科研战略。（财联社）

title_i18n.zh: 诺奖级AlphaFold团队被拆散，DeepMind科研战略迎重大调整
title_i18n.en: Nobel-class AlphaFold team disbanded, DeepMind's research strategy undergoes major restructuring.
title_i18n.es: El equipo de AlphaFold, de nivel Nobel, se desmantela; la estrategia de investigación de DeepMind experimenta un importante ajuste.

excerpt_i18n.zh: 最新消息显示，谷歌DeepMind已解散其旗下AlphaFold团队。AlphaFold论文最初作者中的大多数成员在过去一年里已被重新分配岗位。这支团队打造了凭借蛋白质结构预测技术获得诺贝尔奖认可的人工智能（AI）系统，这一调整标志着这家全球顶尖AI研究机构正在重新制定科研战略。（财联社）
excerpt_i18n.en: Recent reports indicate that Google DeepMind has disbanded its AlphaFold team. Most of the original authors of the AlphaFold paper have been reassigned over the past year. The team developed the AI system for protein structure prediction that earned Nobel Prize recognition. This restructuring marks a shift in research strategy for the world's leading AI research institution. (Cailianshe)
excerpt_i18n.es: Las últimas noticias indican que Google DeepMind ha disuelto su equipo AlphaFold. La mayoría de los autores originales del artículo de AlphaFold han sido reasignados en el último año. Este equipo desarrolló un sistema de inteligencia artificial (IA) que obtuvo reconocimiento del Premio Nobel por su tecnología de predicción de estructuras de proteínas. Este ajuste señala que esta institución de investigación de IA de primer nivel mundial está reformulando su estrategia científica. (Cailianshe)

items.title: AI Security Leaderboard – comparing cyber and CBRN safeguards
items.raw_excerpt: There's no shortage of leaderboards for model capabilities - but the security of models is becoming increasingly relevant, from the risk of an AI agent processing unsanitized input being hijacked to models being pulled due to cybersecurity jailbreaks. We developed an automated test suite that runs models through 1500 automatically generated jailbreak attempts and measures the number of universal jailbreaks: prompts that elicit compliant, detailed responses to >75% clearly harmful questions within a domain (like offensive cybersecurity). We find a big gap between the most robust models -- Fable 5 and GPT-5.6 Sol -- and other leading frontier models -- Gemini 3.1 Pro and Grok 4.5. This is v1.0 and we plan to update with new attacks and broader datasets in the future; we'd love to hear from H

title_i18n.en: AI Security Leaderboard – comparing cyber and CBRN safeguards
title_i18n.zh: AI安全排行榜——比较网络与CBRN防护措施
title_i18n.es: Tabla de clasificación de seguridad de IA – comparando las salvaguardas cibernéticas y las CBRN

excerpt_i18n.en: There's no shortage of leaderboards for model capabilities - but the security of models is becoming increasingly relevant, from the risk of an AI agent processing unsanitized input being hijacked to models being pulled due to cybersecurity jailbreaks. We developed an automated test suite that runs models through 1500 automatically generated jailbreak attempts and measures the number of universal jailbreaks: prompts that elicit compliant, detailed responses to >75% clearly harmful questions within a domain (like offensive cybersecurity). We find a big gap between the most robust models -- Fable 5 and GPT-5.6 Sol -- and other leading frontier models -- Gemini 3.1 Pro and Grok 4.5. This is v1.0 and we plan to update with new attacks and broader datasets in the future; we'd love to hear from H
excerpt_i18n.zh: 模型能力的排行榜比比皆是——但模型的安全性正变得越来越重要，从AI代理处理未净化输入而被劫持的风险，到模型被下架。
excerpt_i18n.es: No faltan clasificaciones de capacidades de modelos, pero la seguridad de los modelos se está volviendo cada vez más relevante, desde el riesgo de que un agente de IA que procesa entradas no saneadas sea secuestrado hasta modelos que son retirados.
